title: Apple Wants to Fix Safari's Cramped Layout on iPhone Duo
snippet: Apple is considering changes to Safari on the iPhone Duo that would give websites access to more of the outer display, although the company has yet to settle on an approach. The challenge is allowing pages to occupy the area beneath Safari's side-mounted controls without making parts of a website inaccessible. In an Friday, October 23 WebKit post, Apple's Jen Simmons explained that an existing web setting could enable this, but Apple's research suggests many sites would not handle it correctly.

title: OpenMobile-2 proves open-source smartphone agents can rival proprietary models
snippet: Smartphone agents don't get better by processing more data. They improve by training on as many different apps as possible.
